newsletter.markdown:
1. **Discovery & Translational Science**

- **E3 ligase UBE4A protects against MASLD/MASH via ERAD targeting of SCD1** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.07.757434) — *bioRxiv*
  - Preclinical studies demonstrate that cytosolic E3 ubiquitin ligase UBE4A maintains hepatic endoplasmic reticulum (ER) homeostasis during nutritional stress via ER-associated protein degradation (ERAD).
  - Hepatocyte-specific UBE4A deletion in mice exacerbated high-fat diet-induced steatosis, inflammation, insulin resistance, and ER stress.
  - Proteomic analysis identified the key lipogenic enzyme stearoyl-CoA desaturase-1 (SCD1) as a direct ERAD degradation target of UBE4A.

- **Lactate-FoxO1 pathway drives CD4⁺ PD-1⁺ T-cell senescence in rheumatoid arthritis** [npj Aging](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41514-026-00542-y) — *npj Aging*
  - Research demonstrates that the lactate-FoxO1 signaling axis promotes cellular senescence in CD4⁺ PD-1⁺ T cells.
  - The driven accumulation of senescent T cells contributes directly to persistent inflammation and disease progression in rheumatoid arthritis.

- **Host and infused neutralizing antibodies drive post-ART viral control in HIV** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04714-x) — *Nature Medicine*
  - A secondary trial analysis demonstrates that both host autologous antibodies and administered broadly neutralizing antibodies (bNAbs) delay HIV viral rebound following analytical treatment interruption of antiretroviral therapy (ART).
  - Findings suggest synergistic contributions of native and passive humoral immunity for achieving durable, ART-free HIV control.

- **RNA and proteomic HER2 profiling identifies pan-tumor candidates beyond ERBB2 amplification** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.11.26365242) — *medRxiv*
  - Biomarker analysis across 1,331 discovery and 3,898 validation tumor biopsies shows ERBB2 mRNA and RNA-signature screening identify HER2-enriched expression profiles missed by ERBB2 gene amplification and standard IHC/FISH.
  - Patients with ERBB2 mRNA-positive tumors receiving HER2-directed therapy demonstrated significantly longer time on treatment (HR 0.42, 95% CI 0.27–0.64) and overall survival (HR 0.41, 95% CI 0.25–0.65).

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II**

- **[Big Pharma]** **Talazoparib plus enzalutamide improves PSA response in Phase 2 mHSPC study** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04671-5) — *Nature Medicine*
  - The randomized Phase 2 ZZ-FIRST trial evaluated PARP inhibitor talazoparib in combination with androgen receptor inhibitor enzalutamide versus enzalutamide monotherapy in high-volume metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer (mHSPC).
  - The combination therapy yielded superior prostate-specific antigen (PSA) response rates compared to enzalutamide alone.
  - Spatial transcriptomic analyses revealed AR inhibition suppressed homologous recombination repair (HRR) pathways, driving proliferation arrest rather than inducing functional HRR deficiency.

- **Personalized neoantigen vaccine with PD-1 blockade shows activity in Phase 1 ovarian cancer trial** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04717-8) — *Nature Medicine*
  - A Phase 1 trial evaluated personalized neoantigen-targeting cancer vaccines combined with PD-1 checkpoint inhibition in patients with high-grade serous ovarian cancer.
  - The regimen was feasible and generated tumor-specific immune responses in a majority of treated patients.
  - Cell-free DNA (cfDNA) monitoring identified acquired mechanisms of therapeutic resistance tied to defects in cellular antigen presentation.

- **BCG immunotherapy yields long-term HbA1c reductions in Phase 2 trial in diabetes** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.09.26365133) — *medRxiv*
  - An 8-year double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 trial evaluated repeat administration of Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG) for immune training in patients with diabetes.
  - BCG-treated patients achieved sustained mean HbA1c reductions from baseline of 7.04% at Year 5 (p = 0.0006) and 12.84% at Year 8 (p = 0.0001), compared to no change in the placebo group (longitudinal comparison p = 0.0017).

- **[Biotech]** **Verastem reports early-stage VS-7375 clinical data** [BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2110309986580500730) — *BioStocks*
  - VS-7375 demonstrated anti-tumor activity across advanced KRAS G12D-mutant cancers, highlighted by a 50% confirmed overall response rate in second-line pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and two complete responses in second-line and later disease.

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III**

- **[Biotech]** **BioNTech mRNA cancer vaccine misses primary PFS readout in head and neck cancer study** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/biontech-mrna-immunotherapy-hpv16-head-neck-cancer/832854/) — *BioPharma Dive*
  - BioNTech announced that its experimental mRNA cancer immunotherapy BNT113 combined with Keytruda failed to significantly extend progression-free survival (PFS) at an interim analysis in a late-stage trial for first-line HPV16-positive head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
  - An independent data monitoring committee advised continuing the study to evaluate overall survival (OS), its co-primary endpoint.
  - BioNTech noted the combination demonstrated therapeutic mechanism engagement, maintaining the possibility of success upon final OS analysis.

- **[Biotech]** **Viking Therapeutics outlines SUNRISE-1 and SUNRISE-2 trial designs** [BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2110340926992179661) — *BioStocks*
  - Both Phase 3 trials will target enrollment of 560 adults evaluating oral VK2735 versus placebo.
  - The primary endpoint for both studies is the percent change in body weight from baseline after 68 weeks of treatment.

4. **Regulatory & Approvals**

- **Analysis reveals ~40% of FDA advisory panels include reps with pharma funding ties** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/10/13/many-patient-and-consumer-reps-on-fda-advisory-committees-ties-to-groups-funded-by-pharma/) — *STAT*
  - A 20-year retrospective analysis found that nearly 40% of FDA advisory committee meetings featured patient or consumer representatives with active financial ties to pharmaceutical company-funded advocacy groups.

- **[Biotech]** **Atara Biotherapeutics secures FDA acceptance of tabelecleucel BLA resubmission** [BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2110342608165769393) — *BioStocks*
  - The FDA accepted the resubmitted Biologics License Application for tabelecleucel (tab-cel) with a set Prescription Drug User Fee Act target action date of March 31, 2027.

5. **Business & Strategy**

- **[Big Pharma]** **Roche licenses Rona Therapeutics RNAi obesity candidate in $1B arrangement** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/roche-rona-china-deal-rnai-obesity-drug-alk7/832845/) — *BioPharma Dive*
  - Roche agreed to pay Rona Therapeutics $100 million upfront for global rights to an experimental RNA interference (RNAi) drug targeting ALK7.
  - Total potential transaction value exceeds $1 billion contingent on development, regulatory, and commercial milestones, plus tiered sales royalties.
  - The deal marks Roche's 10th partnership with a China-based drugmaker since early 2025 and expands its clinical obesity pipeline to six programs.

- **[Biotech]** **Velaris Therapeutics completes reverse merger with Alaunos Therapeutics** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/velaris-alaunos-paragon-reverse-merger-acquisition-fairmount/832869/) — *BioPharma Dive*
  - Paragon Labs spinout Velaris Therapeutics went public via a reverse merger with former cell therapy company Alaunos Therapeutics.
  - Backed and led by investor Fairmount Funds, the combined public company will focus exclusively on Velaris's pipeline for cardiovascular and pulmonary diseases.

- **[Big Pharma]** **BlackRock to purchase $2.8B majority stake in Humana CenterWell clinics** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/13/blackrock-humana-centerwell-deal-senior-care-medicare-clinics/) — *STAT*
  - BlackRock reached an agreement to acquire a majority stake in Humana's CenterWell Senior Primary Care clinic network for $2.8 billion.
  - The transaction replaces private equity firm Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe as Humana's primary senior primary care clinic joint venture partner.

- **FTC files contempt motion against Martin Shkreli over ongoing pharma stock trades** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/13/martin-shkreli-pharma-bro-ftc-contempt-stock-trades/) — *STAT*
  - The Federal Trade Commission petitioned a federal court to hold Martin Shkreli in contempt for allegedly violating his lifetime ban on pharmaceutical industry involvement.

- **[Biotech]** **Verastem announces executive departure, financing, and clinical updates** [JacobPlieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2110313601059672254) — *JacobPlieth*
  - The company reported data for VS-7375, executed a 250 million dollar capital raise, and noted the departure of its CEO.

- **[Biotech]** **Liquidia settles litigation and resolves legal disputes** [BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2110125369881923783) — *BioStocks*
  - Liquidia fully resolved all six ongoing lawsuits with United Therapeutics, maintaining uninterrupted patient access to YUTREPIA for pulmonary arterial hypertension.
  - Liquidia will pay a net 380.7 million dollars in multiple installments across 2026 and 2027, which includes resolution of antitrust litigation.
  - The company reported preliminary unaudited Q3 2026 YUTREPIA net product sales of 222.7 million dollars, contributing to a cash and cash equivalents balance of 396.1 million dollars as of September 30, 2026, alongside an upgrade to Buy at BTIG with a 70 dollar price target.

6. **Public Health & Policy**

- **Physician groups and lobbyists compete to shape state clinical AI regulations** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/14/lobbyists-trade-groups-ama-push-autonomous-clinical-ai-regulations/) — *STAT*
  - Medical associations including the American Medical Association (AMA) and healthcare trade organizations are lobbying state lawmakers over legislative rules governing autonomous clinical AI deployment.

**Worth watching:** Final overall survival readouts from BioNTech's BNT113 head and neck cancer trial, alongside clinical advancement of Roche's newly expanded ALK7 RNAi metabolic program.

youtube.markdown:
- Biology & Health
    - [New Vitamin K2 Study](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/HvP4vhYvhDA) -- Physionic
        - A 2-year randomized trial investigated vitamin K2 MK-7 supplementation and its effects on coronary artery calcification progression.
        - Vitamin K2 functions by activating Matrix Gla Protein (MGP), which inhibits calcium crystal formation and growth within arterial walls.
        - Participants taking vitamin K2 experienced less progression of coronary artery calcification compared to the placebo group.
        - The study did not measure soft plaque or determine whether reducing calcification decreases cardiovascular events like heart attacks, leaving its clinical benefit on overall atherosclerosis unproven.
- Pure Science
    - [14 - Lady  #mathctober](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/VLfCiE2Xtx0) -- El Jj
        - The video opens with a question introducing Ada Lovelace.
- Other
    - [Why Don’t More People Vote?: Crash Course US Government #4](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xsxcuVjn3NA) -- CrashCourse
        - In 2024, approximately 90 million U.S. registered voters chose not to vote, contributing to the U.S. having some of the lowest voter turnout among developed democracies.
        - Low voter turnout is examined through two primary lenses: individual voter behavior and the structural systems that influence civic participation.
        - The episode is structured into distinct chapters covering non-voters, voter turnout statistics, individual accountability versus systemic barriers, and a review of the factors involved.
